coverage.numbers: Ho 25-case <15s, Kakagia 50/82 and costs, Johnson remaining-open 5/5 vs 1/9, Pons 12 ex-vivo tests, Onoe 13/12 and Arumugam 19 wounds contextualized; two source internal discrepancies noted.

coverage.anatomyTechnique: 1985 15-minute SEM observations scoped; ex-vivo force is not in-vivo injury or safe ischemia time. Ureteral technique not equivalent to arterial occlusion.
coverage.followUp: Wound closure depends on edema/perfusion; Onoe retensioning every 2–3 days as example; Steen no-ED-return not universal no-recurrence.
coverage.importedDataFigures: No local figures, video or imported data; two MDX tables preserved. Pons and Onoe figure captions and tables as available text, not pixels.
coverage.references: All 11 inherited references retained; three product/review sources added. Legacy Stahlfeld/Asgari and individual GU uses not fully checked.
coverage.currency: September 2026 review of 2025 primary/review literature and 2022 DeRoyal IFU; TELIC catalog date and in-service product version not verified.
